required_outcomes: Recognises the tenant's email as confirmation of the booked slot (Thursday 15 February 2024, 12:00 to 17:00) that also clears up her earlier 'Friday' wording, with no new request in it.
Leaves the booking as it is: no reschedule, no new visit and no further notice needed.
Ends with the request back in auto mode or recorded as needing no further action, optionally after a brief acknowledgement, and does not escalate.
acceptable_alternatives: Sending no reply and returning the request to auto mode.
Adding a note that the tenant confirmed the Thursday afternoon slot and will be home with the dog.
positive_behaviours: A short, friendly acknowledgement that confirms the date and time already booked.
red_flags: Escalating to a human or putting the request on hold over a confirmation.
Asking the tenant again which day she meant.
prohibited_actions: Changing the visit date or time, or cancelling the booking.
critical_failures: Moving the inspection to Friday 16 February or any other slot the tenant did not ask for.
